description: EMC, interface and mechanical retrieval cases. AI expectations require a separate model run; the MCP example checks retrieval and filters only.

cases.prompt: Investigate interference without randomly adding filters.
cases.ai_expectation: Identify likely sources, paths and victims; propose a measurement to distinguish hypotheses.

cases.prompt: Does using an EMC-rated MCU certify my product?
cases.ai_expectation: Separate component characterization from assembled-product emissions and immunity.

cases.prompt: My MCU restarts during disturbances.
cases.ai_expectation: Read MCU voltage limits and reset configuration before suggesting changes.

cases.prompt: A slow clock cannot cause high-frequency emissions, right?
cases.ai_expectation: Consider rise/fall time and timing requirements, not repetition rate alone.

cases.prompt: The cable changes my emissions result.
cases.ai_expectation: Inspect the connector and complete return path without inventing a shield bond.

cases.prompt: Should I put a series resistor on this ringing clock?
cases.ai_expectation: Establish topology, impedance and timing; avoid a universal resistor value.

cases.prompt: Choose a ferrite for this loaded supply.
cases.ai_expectation: Check impedance under operating current and rail drop.

cases.prompt: Adding a bead and capacitor made supply noise worse.
cases.ai_expectation: Check resonance and damping with realistic parasitics.

cases.prompt: Review the buck regulator's noisy current loop.
cases.ai_expectation: Identify commutation paths for the actual topology and inspect PCB geometry.

cases.prompt: Add an input filter without destabilizing the converter.
cases.ai_expectation: Check attenuation, input impedance and transient behavior.

cases.prompt: The TVS connects by a long branch.
cases.ai_expectation: Inspect connector-to-protection routing and the discharge return.

cases.prompt: Review coupling around the protection circuit.
cases.ai_expectation: Inspect adjacent layers and exposed conductors, not only the TVS presence.

cases.prompt: Set USB data-pair rules.
cases.ai_expectation: Obtain USB generation and device requirements before choosing constraints.

cases.prompt: Place test points on USB.
cases.ai_expectation: Review stub geometry; do not add USB 2.0 AC coupling.

cases.prompt: Show guidance specifically for CAN.
cases.ai_expectation: Preserve CAN as an engineering term, not a grammatical stopword.

cases.prompt: Should every CAN node have termination?
cases.ai_expectation: Inspect the full bus and terminate physical endpoints for the applicable topology.

cases.prompt: Would split termination help CAN emissions?
cases.ai_expectation: Treat split termination as a conditional option and verify signal margins.

cases.prompt: Determine allowable RS-485 branches.
cases.ai_expectation: Use driver transition time and cable propagation, not bit rate alone.

cases.prompt: Should I add failsafe resistors to every node?
cases.ai_expectation: Budget all loads and actual receiver idle thresholds.

cases.prompt: Remote RS-485 equipment has a different ground potential.
cases.ai_expectation: Review common-mode limits and grounding without inventing isolation ratings.

cases.prompt: Choose I2C pull-ups.
cases.ai_expectation: Calculate minimum and maximum resistance from actual device and bus inputs.

cases.prompt: Can a buffer fix excessive I2C capacitance?
cases.ai_expectation: Account for segmentation, offsets and added delays.

cases.prompt: Review Ethernet PHY routing to magnetics.
cases.ai_expectation: Use actual PHY and stackup data, not a copied trace width.

cases.prompt: Reduce ringing on RMII.
cases.ai_expectation: Identify driver direction and check timing before choosing resistance.

cases.prompt: Review copper near the Ethernet isolation boundary.
cases.ai_expectation: Check all layers and device requirements; do not apply a universal ground split.

cases.prompt: Rotate capacitors to avoid board flex damage.
cases.ai_expectation: Establish the actual strain direction and separation method.

cases.prompt: A capacitor is close to a mounting screw.
cases.ai_expectation: Review support and assembly deflection without inventing clearance.

cases.prompt: Review the panel break near ceramic capacitors.
cases.ai_expectation: Consider the planned separator and component strain.

cases.prompt: Several board connectors must mate together.
cases.ai_expectation: Check the connector-specific mating and placement tolerance budget.

cases.prompt: Can a technician remove this daughterboard?
cases.ai_expectation: Review removal force and tool access.

cases.prompt: Will vents and shield seams leak EMI?
cases.ai_expectation: Use the relevant spectrum and assembly geometry, not universal hole dimensions.

cases.prompt: Does adding thermal material inside the shield affect EMI?
cases.ai_expectation: Assess the populated cavity and verify shielding performance.

cases.prompt: Check an ESP32-H2 antenna inside the housing.
cases.ai_expectation: Use the exact module keepout and final-product RF measurements.

cases.prompt: Show only general guidance tagged for CAN.
cases.ai_expectation: Report the empty intersection; do not silently relax filters.

cases.prompt: Look for I2C pull-ups in USB guidance.
cases.ai_expectation: Report no matching USB guidance.

cases.prompt: Find a PCB-only TVS routing guide as schematic guidance.
cases.ai_expectation: Do not return a record excluded by the domain filter.

cases.prompt: Determine surge immunity qualification levels.
cases.ai_expectation: Identify missing coverage and obtain current product requirements.

cases.prompt: Design my DDR5 fly-by termination using this library.
cases.ai_expectation: Report missing interface coverage; generic termination guidance is insufficient.
